b: The latest edition of the event takes in performances from Abdullah Miniawy, Gnäw and more
Tehran Contemporary Sounds Festival is taking place in Berlin this week.

Stretching out across six days, the seventh edition of the event brings together live performances, film screenings, talks and audiovisual presentations. The programming, which largely celebrates work by the Iranian diaspora, is spread across Berlin's Silent Green Kulturquartier venue, while film screenings are taking place at Moviemento Kino.

The bulk of the music programming appears across this week, from 13 to 15 November. It will feature performances from Abdullah Miniawy, Gnäw, Ava Rasti and the duo Tehran, among others. Check out the full schedule of events here.
